description: This file defines the 'Tax' class within the Opencart system, responsible for handling tax calculations, setting addresses related to shipping, payment, and store, and managing tax rates and rules.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Class to manage tax rules, addresses, and calculations within the Opencart eCommerce system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database and configuration objects from the registry.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the shipping address characterized by country and zone IDs.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the payment address characterized by country and zone IDs.

methods.name: setStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets tax rates based on the store's address characterized by country and zone IDs.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total amount including taxes for a given value and tax class.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the tax amount for a specific value and tax class without adding to the original value.

methods.name: getRateName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a tax rate given its ID.

methods.name: getRates
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax rates and their amounts for a given value and tax class.
